description: React component for rendering combined system messages related to user actions in channels and teams, such as joining, leaving, adding, or removing users, with internationalization support.

classes.name: CombinedSystemMessage
classes.description: React component class for displaying formatted system messages about user actions in channels and teams.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Loads user profiles when component mounts.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Reloads user profiles if user ID or username props change.

methods.name: loadUserProfiles
methods.description: Fetches missing user profiles based on user IDs and usernames.

methods.name: getAllUsernames
methods.description: Returns a mapping of user IDs and usernames to display names, including current user.

methods.name: getUsernamesByIds
methods.description: Returns usernames for given user IDs, excluding current user unless specified.

methods.name: renderFormattedMessage
methods.description: Renders a formatted system message based on post type and user IDs.

methods.name: renderMessage
methods.description: Renders individual message with line break.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the list of system messages based on message data.
